title: Y Combinator Startup Lead Scraper Input
description: Filter the YC directory and extract startup leads. Pay per lead.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Match company name, one-liner, description, industry, or tags (e.g. fintech, ai, healthcare). Empty matches all.

batches.title: Batches
batches.description: Limit to YC batches, e.g. 'Summer 2026', 'Winter 2025'. Empty includes all batches.

industries.title: Industries
industries.description: Match the company industry or subindustry (e.g. Fintech, Healthcare, B2B). Empty includes all.

onlyHiring.title: Only companies hiring
onlyHiring.description: Keep only companies currently marked as hiring. Useful for recruiters.

minTeamSize.title: Minimum team size
minTeamSize.description: Drop companies below this team size. Zero keeps everything.

maxLeads.title: Max leads
maxLeads.description: Cap total leads per run, ranked by most recent batch then team size.

includeEmail.title: Scrape contact emails
includeEmail.description: Fetch each company website and scrape a contact email.

maxEmailLookups.title: Max email lookups
maxEmailLookups.description: Cap how many top leads get the website email scrape.
